description: Base permissions for the main window. This file replaces the capability tauri-build generates when the directory is absent, so core:default has to be listed explicitly. start-dragging is added on top: the title bar is an overlay and the tab strip stands in for it, so the window is dragged from the webview. core:window:default grants internal-toggle-maximize but not start-dragging, which is why double-click zoomed the window and dragging did nothing.
